experiment_data.hypothesis: 8+ diverse LLM judges (proprietary + open-source) on MT-Bench and Arena-Hard with position-swapped pairwise evaluation will produce sufficient multi-facet data to detect and quantify judge-specific severity (d_j) and item-level contamination effects (c_n·e_i), enabling G-MFRM joint calibration to outperform sequential pipelines on real data.
